milestone.title: Multi-ECS scale-out
milestone.final_goal: Promote the proven native multi-ECS lifecycle through exact real 500, 1000, and 2000 node runs without weakening safety, evidence quality, cleanup, or comparison against the admitted 200-node baseline.

success_conditions.statement: Every supported scale has explicit profiles and a fail-closed resource and cost preflight.
Scale orchestration is bounded, ownership-aware, restartable, and deterministic at every required rung.
Telemetry and evidence transfer remain complete, bounded, attributable, and product-digest bound at scale.
Hierarchical control preserves exact scale, fault containment, deterministic cleanup, and operator approval boundaries.
Validated reports compare each admitted scale with the sealed 200-node baseline and the immediately preceding admitted scale.
A current trusted capture promoted from M2 proves the complete distributed flow at exactly 500 observed Valkey nodes.
A current trusted capture promoted from the admitted 500-node result proves the complete distributed flow at exactly 1000 observed Valkey nodes.
A current trusted capture promoted from the admitted 1000-node result proves the complete distributed flow at exactly 2000 observed Valkey nodes.

real_evidence_requirements.statement: Admit an operator-approved native multi-ECS scale-flow capture at exactly 500 requested and observed nodes, promoted from the sealed M2 completion.
Admit an operator-approved native multi-ECS scale-flow capture at exactly 1000 requested and observed nodes, promoted from the admitted 500-node capture.
Admit an operator-approved native multi-ECS scale-flow capture at exactly 2000 requested and observed nodes, promoted from the admitted 1000-node capture.
